name: Timescan Logistics (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2006, Timescan Logistics (India) Ltd does business of providing customs clearance & surface logistics services viz. goods transport service along with warehousing facilities
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1][2]
a) Freight Forwarding
b) Custom Clearance
c) Warehousing
d) Transportation
e) Multimodal Transportation
f) Project Cargo / Odc Consignments
g) Break Bulk / Heavy Lift
h) Vessel Charter / Chartering
i) Fcl / Lcl Consolidation
j) Equipment Rentals / Turnkey Projects
k) Iso / Flexi Tanks / Hazardous Cargo
l) NVOCC
m) 3pl/4pl
n) Packaging / Palletization / Fumigation
o) Vendor Management
p) Other Value Added Services

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 49.4% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
